title: Automated deprecation orchestration: notices, pin-safe migrations, and rollback strategy
creator: Leila Park
description: Goal: define and ship an automated orchestration workflow for retiring old model versions that preserves customer pins, publishes performance-profile migration guidance, and provides safe rollback/fallback behavior. This ticket covers the product requirements, notification templates, console UI hooks, and runbook for cross-team coordination (eng/reliability/support). The workflow should be extensible to managed and private deployments and integrate with the model catalog, performance profile publisher, and rollout controls.
acceptance_criteria: A1: A deprecation policy engine exists in the console to schedule retirements with configurable embargo, notice, and grace periods
A2: Customers with pinned model versions receive targeted notices with an in-console action to 1) pin a suggested compatible replacement or 2) request extended grace by opening a support case

A3: For each retiring model version we publish a migration card that includes: performance profile comparisons (latency/cost/quality), recommended pin mappings, quantization notes, and a small sample migration PR template
A4: A safe fallback policy is enforced: if replacement capacity is unavailable at rollout time, requests are routed to a compatible variant and a mitigation alert is raised to SRE
A5: Documentation and runbook exist for the Support and Solutions teams (confluence KB + canned responses), and a post-mortem template for regressions
